name: dev-harness
description: Spec → build → test → review loop for a non-coding owner. Three human gates enforced by hooks: (1) spec approval, (2) every paid external API call (+ daily USD cap), (3) merge to main. Plus an autoresearch-style overnight autoloop for free metrics with locked evaluators, and a retro loop that turns owner lessons and gate events into repo lessons and harness PRs.
